notes.title: Grim Trials Demo Out Now - The Academy Accepts Grim Reaper Recruits!
notes.content:
[i]The carousel of games won't stop spinning... and it's calling you.[/i]

Join the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32940668/sale/carnivalofchaos]Neon Doctrine Carnival of Chaos[/url]; a chilling, thrilling, killer collection of ghoulish games and devilish demos, [b]featuring a playable demo for our upcoming slash n' blast roguelike, Grim Trials![/b]

[previewyoutube=4ApR7CLyiUg;full][/previewyoutube]

Death claimed Avelin's soul, but she refuses to accept her fate. She'll fight her way back to the land of the living for her lost love—as many times as it takes.

[h3][b]Ready to join the Academy? Enter the world of Grim Reapers in training during the Carnival of Chaos by playing the demo NOW![/b][/h3]
